# Historical Scene execution audit

**Provenance.** All citations below identify expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/`. Their archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--sceneevolve_cli.tar.gz`; each corresponding member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/` plus the cited relative file path. Line numbers refer to the supplied expanded text.

## Historic metalworking workshop — commons_155212263

**Generated representation and settings.** The selected step’s code builds a workshop from named assets and box, rod and swept-tube parts: plank flooring and windows; a long bench; a lathe with segmented rim and swept spokes; an anvil; vises; drawer; tools; and containers. The target barrel uses a bottom, 20 rotated staves and 20 rim segments. These are constructed placements, not measured proof of contact or image fidelity (X0849, `test/commons_155212263/steps/001/build.py`, lines 28–70, 93–154, 168–196, 253–275). The code assigns wood, iron, steel and rust colors, then adds noise-driven color ramps and bump to eligible Principled materials, with conditional metallic and emission settings (X0849, lines 19–25, 299–333).

The camera is at (5, −7.1, 4.25), aimed at (−0.85, 0, 1.48), with 39 mm lens and 36 mm sensor; three area emitters and a colored world provide lighting (X0849, lines 8–10, 335–349). The task specifies a **512 × 384 reference**, not independently measured output dimensions (X0851, `test/commons_155212263/task.json`, lines 2–5).

**Execution and validation.** Step 1 reports `ok: true`, no error, and Blender 4.2.10 finishing 16 samples and saving both `final.png` and `scene.blend`; stderr is empty (X0850, `test/commons_155212263/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7). Selection separately records step 1 (X0847, `test/commons_155212263/selected.json`, lines 1–3). The run record nevertheless contains a subsequent student-process exit-1 traceback: this is a policy/LLM-call failure, not evidence that the completed step’s render failed. The record says complete, one execution, CPU render, and `selected: null` (X0846, `test/commons_155212263/record.json`, lines 16–18, 37–57, 58–72).

The recorded valid flag and structural, material and composite passes concern edit operability; semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Recorded SSIM is 0.1523, LPIPS 0.7729 and overall 0.3858—not independent visual acceptance (X0846, lines 17–34). A separate text-edit status says complete with exit 0 for a requested blue workbench material edit, but does not itself prove the requested appearance or preservation of other objects (X0852, `test/commons_155212263/text_edit/status.json`, lines 2–5).

## Electronics workbench — commons_16007442

**Generated representation and revisions.** The final expanded build uses separately named composite assets for the bench, cabinets, monitor, oscilloscope, meters, keyboard, lamp, soldering equipment and cables. The lamp comprises clamp, rods, hinge, shade, diffuser and cord; its placements do not establish physical connections. The monitor is rotated 24°, the upright meter tilted and scaled, and the cable group stretched (X0853, `test/commons_16007442/build.py`, lines 25–50, 85–102, 151–165, 206–218, 259–280).

Between step 1 and the later build, camera x changes from +0.48 to −0.48, bench depth from 1.40 to 1.70, and monitor dimensions increase; these are coded parameters, not measured geometry (X0857, `test/commons_16007442/steps/001/build.py`, lines 9–14; X0853, lines 9–14). The final code sets a 45 mm lens, 36 mm sensor, two area lights and world illumination; materials receive roughness 0.72 and conditional blue-screen emission, with no image-texture operation shown (X0853, lines 309–349).

**Execution and selection.** Step 1 successfully finished a 16-sample Blender render and saved image and blend files (X0858, `test/commons_16007442/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7). The record reports three executions, CPU render history, complete status and no runtime error; selection records step 3. The supplied text does not include step 3’s individual result, so its render cannot be independently inspected here (X0854, `test/commons_16007442/record.json`, lines 16–18, 37–51, 58–86; X0855, `test/commons_16007442/selected.json`, lines 1–3).

The record reports valid and functional passes for the lamp, but explicitly limits them to structural/edit operability; completeness and collision truth remain null. SSIM 0.1512 and overall 0.4757 are recorded metrics, not validated visual quality (X0854, lines 17–34). No reference or rendered images were supplied for visual comparison; completed rendering and potentially poor reconstruction must therefore remain distinct conclusions.
